name: Three's Company Future Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Three's Company Future Technology Group Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated marketing services company in China. The company's services include full-process planning, creative, execution, and communication services in areas such as full-case digital marketing and scenario marketing. It operates through four business divisions including marketing, industrial investment, architectural technology, and smart technology.
